name: CiteRAG
description: CiteRAG is the first comprehensive retrieval-augmented generation benchmark for academic citation prediction, featuring multi-level retrieval strategies and two citation prediction tasks at different granularities. It includes a dataset of over 15,800 instances and a large corpus of 554k papers for evaluating retrieval and generation models in academic literature.
reputation: A recent academic RAG benchmark that is useful for citation prediction research, but it is still niche and not yet broadly adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Open-source toolkit and data; first comprehensive evaluation framework for citation prediction.
